issues.description: The full branch still has unresolved required input provenance/construction and parameter-file handoffs. In particular, two distinct counterfactual parameter CSVs have active consumers but no exact matching producer in the supplied stages; the impairment pull also requires a preconstructed ID. Keep the scope open until these contracts are confirmed.

The documented root and packaged paths are not coherent as-is: code changes to a user download root, README names Code/execution_script.R while the supplied root is execution_script.R, active includes use both Code/code, PPA/Data directory case differs across producer/consumer paths, and Julia result objects are written/read under different relative directories. Resolve one consistent case-sensitive root and stage same-product handoffs without changing scientific definitions.

The included block bootstrap is a material resource stage: the README reports 60 cores and 18 hours, with an estimated 45 days on one core. Plan an authorized compute allocation before running this branch.

validation: Trace each exact writer to each consumer and confirm field meaning, date/history and same-product identity without running author code.

actions.description: Create one coherent case-sensitive project root and explicit file handoffs for all included stages.

Map each notebook-produced JLD object to its bootstrap consumer path and preserve the exact produced file bytes; do not substitute parameter CSVs for JLD results.

validation: Resolve every source/include and each producer-consumer pair under the selected root on a case-sensitive filesystem; verify identical logical product names and field contracts.

validation: Confirm the delivered products contain the cited identifiers, date bounds and construction fields and preserve separate inputs and the two link strategies.
